faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Ball Valve Stem suitable for Ball valve stem (Grade 5) for chemical valve?
faq.a: Titanium Ball Valve Stem uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address valve component operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Ball Valve Stem?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Ball Valve Stem is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for ball valve stem requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Ball Valve Stem require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. ball valve stem components require Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for ball valve stem application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Ball Valve Stem shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Ball Valve Stem includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet ball valve stem specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Valve stem / Ball stem valve component components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
